Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I won't pass the Albany news or the Bluefin codename to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't post it in any channel.

Since Mateo told you directly, the cleanest route is for you to brief Ruth yourself, or to ask Mateo to brief her. If you'd like, I can help you set up a meeting with Ruth, but I'd only do that once you tell me to.
